description: AI agents need bounded permissions. Before an agent sends an email, approves a payment or deletes data, require a trusted approval checkpoint with the complete action details. Start with read-only access, log every tool action, and preserve a stop switch. This is a practical control pattern, not a claim of universal legal compliance.
